a.lede: The Jensen Huang era of Nvidia nearly came to an end this month. Huang, who three decades ago cofounded what's come to be considered one of the most important companies in AI, resigned from his role on November 12th over mounting scrutiny around his alleged affairs. a.title: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again

b.lede: The company’s board of directors has reinstated Huang a little more than a week after the CEO resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report.
b.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
